child_match_timings.meaning: Time between native goal events, with up to three ticks reset-boundary rounding. Entry height does not identify aerial control, shot intent or last touch.

child_skill_context.meaning: Each fixed skill case ends at its first native goal or time limit. Natural includes kickoff AND ongoing ground; do not call aggregate kickoff gains general ground play.

summary.no_touch_semantics: Zero by protocol; use matches_without_rival_touch, not reset count

match_comparison.meaning: Matched fixed development cases, not ranked skill or SSL proof. Same-player follow-ups are not possession duration. Later-goal counts have unequal segment exposure. No-touch resets are disabled by protocol. Only comparisons with the same tagged reset/runtime method are allowed.
